title: Emergency HVAC in Alamo Heights, TX
desc: If you’re in need of emergency HVAC in Alamo Heights, TX, call the team at Rosenberg Plumbing & Air. We offer emergency AC service.

blocks.text: The sweltering summers in Texas make having reliable air conditioning essential. If your AC unit won’t start, or it’s making matters worse by blowing warm air on a balmy evening, call Rosenberg Plumbing & Air for responsive, reliable emergency HVAC services in Alamo Heights, TX. You can count on our team to fix all kinds of HVAC issues, so you can enjoy comfort at home all year round.

Our HVAC technicians are available 24 hours a day to conduct emergency AC repairs. We know that you and your family depend on us to keep your HVAC systems running, and we’ll do everything we can to complete any repairs on the first visit. To that end, our team members all have access to company vans stocked with the most common parts, tools, and components required to fix issues with well-known HVAC brands.

blocks.text: We will always work carefully and methodically to diagnose your HVAC problems and fix the underlying issue, not just the symptom. Our technicians always put you, the customer, first and will provide impartial advice based on their educated, professional opinions. We don’t engage in aggressive sales tactics and will never suggest a replacement if an economical repair is possible.

To reduce the likelihood of future breakdowns, we offer a variety of preventative maintenance plans. These plans will take care of common issues such as clogged filters, low refrigerant levels, or dirt build-up around moving parts, helping make your system more energy-efficient and keeping things running as reliably as possible. We promise that our prices will always be fair and transparent, and we won’t charge any surprise fees for our work.

Rosenberg Plumbing & Air has been serving local homeowners since 1994. Over the last three decades we’ve earned an A+ rating with the Better Business Bureau, and numerous awards, including an Angi Super Service Award and recognition as an ACCA Residential Contractor of The Year.

Even more importantly, we’ve earned a long list of five-star reviews from satisfied customers who now choose to turn to us for all their heating and cooling requirements. From annual tune-ups to emergency repairs and upgrades or replacements, our technicians can and do handle it all.

We understand that sometimes breakdowns can happen at an inopportune time. To help you manage your household budget, we provide flexible finance options subject to approved credit. If your broken air conditioner requires significant work or you find yourself choosing to replace an aging system, ask about our finance plans. You may be able to spread the cost of a new unit over several convenient monthly payments.

To learn more about the emergency HVAC services we deliver in Alamo Heights, call Rosenberg Plumbing & Air today. Let us show you why we’re the first choice for AC repairs in the area. We also offer expert assistance with commercial HVAC, ductwork, heat pumps, and more.
